issues.issue: Logging request headers may expose sensitive tokens (e.g., Authorization, Cookie) in logcat.
issues.fix: Redact sensitive headers (e.g., Authorization, Cookie) before logging.

issues.issue: Logging request body may expose sensitive data (e.g., passwords, PII) in logcat.
issues.fix: Avoid logging request bodies or redact sensitive fields before logging.

issues.issue: Logging response body may expose sensitive data (e.g., tokens, PII) in logcat.
issues.fix: Avoid logging response bodies or redact sensitive fields before logging.

issues.issue: Logging response headers may expose sensitive data (e.g., Set-Cookie) in logcat.
issues.fix: Redact sensitive headers (e.g., Set-Cookie) before logging.
